intro.en: Northeastern Italian region joining Garda, Verona, Vicenza and Treviso wine territories.
intro.zh: 意大利东北大区，连接 Garda、Verona、Vicenza 与 Treviso 葡萄酒区域。

body.en: Administrative region
body.zh: 行政大区

body.en: Veneto is an administrative region, not a single DOC.
body.zh: Veneto 是行政大区，不是单一 DOC。

body.en: Verona, Vicenza and Treviso have different grape and wine traditions.
body.zh: Verona、Vicenza、Treviso 品种及酒文化不同。

body.en: DOC recognition dates to 1968.
body.zh: 1968 年获得 DOC。

body.en: The modern Prosecco DOC was established in 2009.
body.zh: 现代 Prosecco DOC 始于 2009 年。

body.en: Amarone became a separate DOCG in 2010.
body.zh: Amarone 于 2010 年成为独立 DOCG。

body.en: Soave lies east of Verona; Valpolicella occupies valleys north of the city.
body.zh: Soave 在 Verona 东侧，Valpolicella 位于城市北侧山谷。

body.en: Bardolino follows the eastern side of Lake Garda.
body.zh: Bardolino 位于 Garda 湖东侧。

body.en: Lake Garda and the Lessini hills affect exposure and air movement in western Veneto.
body.zh: Garda 湖与 Lessini 丘陵影响 Veneto 西部朝向与空气流动。

body.en: Volcanic and limestone hills coexist; Soave is not uniformly basalt.
body.zh: 火山与石灰岩丘陵并存，Soave 非全部玄武岩。

body.en: Glacial morainic hills shape the Bardolino territory.
body.zh: 冰川冰碛丘陵塑造 Bardolino 地貌。

body.en: Garganega leads Soave; Glera leads Prosecco.
body.zh: Garganega 主导 Soave，Glera 主导 Prosecco。

body.en: Durella retains high acid; Vespaiola underpins Breganze Vespaiolo and Torcolato.
body.zh: Durella 保有高酸；Vespaiola 酿 Breganze Vespaiolo 与 Torcolato。

body.en: Corvina, Corvinone and Rondinella are central Valpolicella identities.
body.zh: Corvina、Corvinone、Rondinella 为 Valpolicella 核心。

body.en: Manzoni Bianco is Riesling × Pinot Blanc, selected at Conegliano.
body.zh: Manzoni Bianco 为 Riesling × Pinot Blanc，在 Conegliano 选育。

body.en: Prosecco DOC, Conegliano Valdobbiadene DOCG and Asolo DOCG are separate.
body.zh: Prosecco DOC、Conegliano Valdobbiadene DOCG、Asolo DOCG 各自独立。

body.en: Montebaldo, La Rocca and Sommacampagna.
body.zh: Montebaldo、La Rocca、Sommacampagna。

body.en: Prosecco DOC also covers four Friuli-Venezia Giulia provinces.
body.zh: Prosecco DOC 还覆盖 Friuli-Venezia Giulia 四省。

body.en: Amarone and Recioto use dried grapes; dry-style Amarone contrasts with sweet Recioto.
body.zh: 两者使用风干葡萄，干型风格 Amarone 与甜 Recioto 对比。

body.en: Valpolicella wine undergoes re-fermentation on Amarone or Recioto marc.
body.zh: Valpolicella 酒在 Amarone 或 Recioto 酒渣上再发酵。

body.en: Masi Osar is a varietal Oseleta IGT reference, not Amarone.
body.zh: Masi Osar 为 Oseleta 单品种 IGT 参照，非 Amarone。

body.en: Amarone’s dried-grape concentration does not make it a sweet Recioto.
body.zh: Amarone 的风干浓缩不等于甜型 Recioto。

body.en: Raboso Piave is a high-acid, tannic reference distinct from lighter local reds.
body.zh: Raboso Piave 为高酸高单宁参照，不同于较轻本地红酒。

body.en: Alluvial, glacial, limestone and volcanic materials create diverse sites.

body.en: Hill exposure and drainage matter; regional plains and steep terraces are not equivalent sites.

body.en: Eocene marl and sandstone flysch underpins the Collio reference.

body.en: Limestone and red residual soils occur in the Karst plateau.

body.en: Pignolo, Schioppettino, Tazzelenghe and Refosco dal Peduncolo Rosso are separate.

body.zh: ERSA 记录 Cividin、Cjanorie、Cordenossa、Sagrestana 材料。

body.zh: Rosazzo DOCG 是干白混酿，不同于 Ribolla Gialla di Rosazzo DOC 类型。

body.en: Gorizia, Pordenone, Trieste and Udine fall within Prosecco DOC.

body.en: Colli Orientali del Friuli Picolit is a separate DOCG established in 2006.

body.en: Emilio Bulfon is a reference for recovered varieties including Cividin and Cjanorie.
body.zh: Emilio Bulfon 为 Cividin、Cjanorie 等恢复品种参照。

body.en: The consortium suggests 10–12°C.

body.en: Administrative region

body.en: Emilian Lambrusco districts differ from Romagna’s Albana and Sangiovese traditions.
body.zh: Emilia Lambrusco 区域不同于 Romagna Albana、Sangiovese 传统。

body.en: Multiple varieties and DOCs, not one grape or sweetness level.
body.zh: 涉及多个品种及 DOC，非一种葡萄或固定甜度。

body.en: The regional register documents rare Maligia, Sgavetta and Uva Tosca.
body.zh: 大区名录记录稀有 Maligia、Sgavetta、Uva Tosca。

body.en: Centesimino and Famoso exemplify recovered Romagna varieties.
body.zh: Centesimino、Famoso 展示 Romagna 品种复兴。

body.en: Modena and Reggio Emilia include plains and Apennine foothills.
body.zh: Modena、Reggio Emilia 包含平原及亚平宁山麓。

body.en: Romagna Albana covers parts of Bologna, Ravenna and Forlì-Cesena.
body.zh: Romagna Albana 覆盖 Bologna、Ravenna、Forlì-Cesena 部分地区。

body.en: Hot summers and foggy winters characterize the consortium’s plain-land account.
body.zh: 协会平原描述为炎夏及多雾冬季。

body.en: Uva Tosca needs favourable exposure to ripen in Emilia’s mountain vineyards.
body.zh: Uva Tosca 在 Emilia 山地园需良好朝向成熟。

body.en: River sedimentation left sands, clays and calcareous deposits.
body.zh: 河流沉积留下砂、黏土及钙质沉积物。

body.en: Clay-rich foothills contrast with better-drained higher calcareous sand/gravel sites.
body.zh: 富黏土山麓与高处排水较佳钙质砂砾地对比。

body.en: Sorbara, Grasparossa, Salamino, Maestri, Marani and Viadanese are distinct.
body.zh: Sorbara、Grasparossa、Salamino、Maestri、Marani、Viadanese 各自独立。

body.en: Ancellotta provides anthocyanin colour and is not itself Lambrusco.
body.zh: Ancellotta 提供花色苷颜色，本身非 Lambrusco。

body.en: Fortana has a specific coastal sandy-soil association.
body.zh: Fortana 与海岸沙土有特别联系。

body.en: Romagna Albana DOCG requires at least 95% Albana.
body.zh: Romagna Albana DOCG 至少 95% Albana。

body.en: Sorbara, Grasparossa di Castelvetro, Salamino di Santa Croce, Modena and Reggiano have separate rules.
body.zh: 上述五种 DOC 各有独立规范。

body.en: Colli di Scandiano e di Canossa includes local white as well as Lambrusco types.
body.zh: Colli di Scandiano e di Canossa 也含本地白酒，并非仅 Lambrusco。

body.en: Frizzante and spumante span dry to sweet; pressure and sugar are separate variables.
body.zh: 微起泡及起泡可干至甜，压力与糖为不同变量。

body.en: Dry, sweeter and passito styles are possible; Albana is not only a dessert wine.
body.zh: 可酿干型、带甜及风干酒，并非仅甜酒。

body.en: Regional institutions and growers preserve minor varieties; registration does not prove broad acreage.
body.zh: 地方机构、种植者保育小众品种，登记不代表广泛面积。

body.en: Pietro Pianori’s recovery work is central to the Oriolo/Faenza story.
body.zh: Pietro Pianori 恢复工作是 Oriolo／Faenza 历史关键。

body.en: Sorbara is usually paler/lighter; Grasparossa has more body and tannin.
body.zh: Sorbara 通常更浅更轻，Grasparossa 酒体单宁更多。

body.en: Dry Sorbara is a traditional companion to salumi; verify sweetness first.
body.zh: 干型 Sorbara 传统搭配腌肉，须先确认甜度。

body.zh: Trento 北侧 Campo Rotaliano，近 Mezzolombardo、Mezzocorona。

body.zh: 与 Noce 河相连的砾石冲积土。

intro.en: Sweet Verduzzo Friulano DOCG on the southern slopes of Monte Bernadia around Nimis and Tarcento.
intro.zh: Nimis、Tarcento 周边 Monte Bernadia 南坡的甜型 Verduzzo Friulano DOCG。

body.en: DOCG
body.zh: DOCG

body.en: DOCG devoted to sweet white wine, with a regulated Riserva.
body.zh: 甜白 DOCG，含受规范 Riserva。

body.en: DOCG recognised in 2001.
body.zh: 2001 年获 DOCG。

body.en: Delimited parts of Nimis and Tarcento, Udine province.
body.zh: Udine 省 Nimis、Tarcento 划定部分。

body.en: Terraced south-facing Monte Bernadia slopes, approximately 250–413 metres.
body.zh: Monte Bernadia 朝南梯田坡，约 250–413 米。

body.en: A relatively wet hillside environment; exposure and ventilation matter.
body.zh: 相对多雨的丘陵环境，朝向、通风重要。

body.en: Eocene marls dominate the local hillside setting.
body.zh: 始新世泥灰岩主导当地丘陵。

body.en: 100% Verduzzo Friulano, locally called Verduzzo Giallo.
body.zh: 100% Verduzzo Friulano，本地称 Verduzzo Giallo。

body.en: Not Verduzzo Trevigiano, and not a Picolit blend.
body.zh: 不是 Verduzzo Trevigiano，也非 Picolit 混酿。

body.en: New plantings: at least 3,000 vines/ha.
body.zh: 新植至少 3,000 株／公顷。

body.en: Maximum grape yield 8 t/ha and wine conversion 65%.
body.zh: 葡萄产量最高 8 吨／公顷，出酒率 65%。

body.en: Ordinary wine: November of the year after harvest.
body.zh: 普通酒：采收次年十一月。

body.en: From 1 December of the third year from harvest, as specified in the code.
body.zh: 按规章，自采收起第三年十二月一日起。

body.en: Grapes may dry on the vine or in suitable drying rooms.
body.zh: 葡萄可在藤上或适当风干室失水。

body.en: Wooden vessels are permitted.
body.zh: 允许使用木容器。

body.en: Sweet, full and sometimes tannic, with ripe fruit and honeyed notes.
body.zh: 甜、饱满，有时有单宁，呈熟果、蜂蜜气息。

role.en: Exclusive grape; 100%.
role.zh: 唯一品种，100%。

intro.en: Dry white blend DOCG centred on the Rosazzo hills and abbey in Udine province.
intro.zh: 以 Udine 省 Rosazzo 丘陵、修道院为中心的干白混酿 DOCG。

body.en: DOCG
body.zh: DOCG

body.en: DOCG for a dry white blend.
body.zh: 干白混酿 DOCG。

body.en: Recognised as DOCG in 2011.
body.zh: 2011 年获 DOCG。

body.en: Abbazia di Rosazzo anchors the historical vineyard landscape.
body.zh: Abbazia di Rosazzo 为历史葡萄园景观核心。

body.en: Delimited parts of Manzano, Corno di Rosazzo and San Giovanni al Natisone.
body.zh: Manzano、Corno di Rosazzo、San Giovanni al Natisone 划定部分。

body.en: Marl-sandstone hillside formations link it to eastern Friuli’s flysch landscape.
body.zh: 泥灰岩—砂岩丘陵与 Friuli 东部复理石景观相连。

body.en: At least 50%.

body.zh: 其他适宜白品种最多 5%；各项须合计 100%。

body.zh: 新植至少 4,000 株／公顷。

body.en: Maximum 8 t/ha and 2 kg per vine.
body.zh: 最高 8 吨／公顷、每株 2 千克。

body.en: Wooden vessels are permitted in vinification and maturation.
body.zh: 酿造、熟成可用木容器。

body.en: Livio Felluga’s Abbazia di Rosazzo is an estate reference.
body.zh: Livio Felluga 的 Abbazia di Rosazzo 为庄园参照。

body.en: Rosazzo DOCG is neither a Picolit sweet wine nor the DOC’s Pignolo di Rosazzo.
body.zh: Rosazzo DOCG 既非 Picolit 甜酒，也非 DOC 的 Pignolo di Rosazzo。

intro.en: Sweet Picolit-led DOCG from the eastern Friuli hills, with a separately delimited Cialla subzone.
intro.zh: Friuli 东部丘陵以 Picolit 为主的甜酒 DOCG，含独立划定 Cialla 子区。

body.en: DOCG
body.zh: DOCG

body.en: DOCG separate from Friuli Colli Orientali DOC.
body.zh: 独立于 Friuli Colli Orientali DOC 的 DOCG。

body.en: DOCG recognised in 2006.
body.zh: 2006 年获 DOCG。

body.en: Eastern Udine hill territory.
body.zh: Udine 东部丘陵区域。

body.en: Cialla is a delimited subzone with additional rules.
body.zh: Cialla 为另有条款的划定子区。

body.en: Marl and sandstone geological formations characterise the local hills.
body.zh: 当地丘陵以泥灰岩、砂岩地层为特征。

body.en: Picolit at least 85% for the general DOCG.
body.zh: 一般 DOCG 的 Picolit 至少 85%。

body.en: Other suitable whites up to 15%, excluding Traminer Aromatico.
body.zh: 其他适宜白品种最多 15%，排除 Traminer Aromatico。

body.en: The general 85% rule must not replace the separate Cialla specification.
body.zh: 一般 85% 规则不能取代 Cialla 独立规范。

body.en: Ripe or dried grapes produce sweet, concentrated whites.
body.zh: 成熟或风干葡萄酿甜而浓缩的白酒。

body.en: Drying provides concentration before fermentation.
body.zh: 发酵前风干使葡萄浓缩。

body.en: Picolit is distinct from Ramandolo’s Verduzzo Friulano.
body.zh: Picolit 不同于 Ramandolo 的 Verduzzo Friulano。

body.en: Golden, sweet, floral and concentrated; producer ageing affects texture.
body.zh: 金黄、甜、花香、浓缩；酒庄陈年影响质地。

intro.zh: Trieste、Gorizia 边境石灰岩台地产区，与 Vitovska、Malvasia Istriana、Terrano 相关。

body.en: DOC
body.zh: DOC

body.en: DOC with the equivalent names Carso and Kras.

body.en: Delimited areas in Trieste and Gorizia provinces, near Slovenia.
body.zh: Trieste、Gorizia 两省划定区域，近斯洛文尼亚。

body.en: Karst plateau and slopes above the Adriatic coast.
body.zh: 亚得里亚海岸上方喀斯特台地及坡地。

body.en: Coastal proximity and exposed plateau sites create varied conditions.
body.zh: 海岸邻近性及开放台地造成多样条件。

body.en: Karst limestone and pockets of red clay-rich terra rossa.
body.zh: 喀斯特石灰岩及局部富黏土红色 terra rossa。

body.en: Vitovska and Malvasia Istriana are local references.
body.zh: Vitovska、Malvasia Istriana 为本地参照。

body.en: Terrano is the local red identity linked to Teran.
body.zh: Terrano 为与 Teran 对应的本地红品种。

body.en: Wines from this geographical landscape may carry DOC or other legally eligible labels.
body.zh: 该地理景观中的酒可依法使用 DOC 或其他标签。

body.en: Both direct pressing and producer-specific skin maceration occur.
body.zh: 存在直接压榨及部分酒庄浸皮风格。

body.en: Maceration can deepen white-wine colour; it is not mandatory for all Carso wines.
body.zh: 浸皮可加深白酒颜色，并非所有 Carso 酒强制。

body.en: Zidarich’s cited Vitovska is Venezia Giulia IGP, a geographical reference rather than a DOC example.
body.zh: 所引 Zidarich Vitovska 为 Venezia Giulia IGP，是地理参照而非 DOC 酒例。

body.en: Terrano red and skin-contact Vitovska are distinct grape and wine identities.
body.zh: Terrano 红酒、浸皮 Vitovska 为不同品种及酒身份。

intro.zh: 与广泛砾石冲积物相连的 Friuli 平原 DOC。

body.zh: DOC

body.en: DOC including white, red and named-variety types.
body.zh: 包含白、红及命名品种类型的 DOC。

body.en: Delimited plains in Udine and Pordenone.
body.zh: Udine、Pordenone 的划定平原。

body.en: The Tagliamento and other Alpine rivers shaped the alluvial landscape.
body.zh: Tagliamento 等阿尔卑斯河流塑造冲积地貌。

body.en: Gravel-rich river deposits give the denomination its name.
body.zh: 富砾石河流沉积形成产区名称。

body.en: Gravel depth and finer sediment vary across the broad plain.
body.zh: 广阔平原的砾石深度、细沉积物比例不同。

body.en: Friulano and Verduzzo Friulano occur alongside international whites.
body.zh: Friulano、Verduzzo Friulano 与国际白品种并存。

body.en: Pinot Gris, Chardonnay and Sauvignon are important references.
body.zh: Pinot Gris、Chardonnay、Sauvignon 为重要参照。

body.en: Merlot, Cabernet varieties and Refosco dal Peduncolo Rosso.
body.zh: Merlot、Cabernet 各品种、Refosco dal Peduncolo Rosso。

body.en: Each named-variety type follows its own composition and analytical requirements.
body.zh: 各命名品种类型有自己的组成及分析要求。

body.en: Still, frizzante or spumante types are defined individually by the code.
body.zh: 规章分别规定静止、微起泡或起泡类型。

body.en: Wood treatment is permitted; it is not obligatory for every wine.
body.zh: 可使用木容器，并非每款酒强制。

body.en: A broad alluvial plain origin, distinct from Collio’s border hills.

intro.zh: Modena 平原 DOC，尤以色浅、芳香、酸度鲜明的红及桃红 Lambrusco 著称。

body.en: DOC
body.zh: DOC

body.en: DOC for red and rosé Lambrusco styles.
body.zh: 红、桃红 Lambrusco DOC。

body.en: Twelve municipalities on the Modena plain, including Bomporto and Bastiglia.
body.zh: Modena 平原十二市镇，包括 Bomporto、Bastiglia。

body.en: North of Modena, around Sorbara.
body.zh: Modena 北侧 Sorbara 周围。

body.en: River-deposited plain soils with varying sand, silt and clay.
body.zh: 河流冲积平原土，沙、粉砂、黏土比例不同。

body.en: Lambrusco di Sorbara at least 60%.
body.zh: Lambrusco di Sorbara 至少 60%。

body.en: Lambrusco Salamino may contribute up to 40%.
body.zh: Lambrusco Salamino 可占最多 40%。

body.en: Other permitted Lambrusco varieties up to 15%, within the total blend.
body.zh: 其他获准 Lambrusco 最多 15%，计入总混酿。

body.en: Dry through sweeter categories are possible under the code.
body.zh: 规章下可有干至较甜类型。

body.en: The individual maxima cannot be added beyond a total of 100%.
body.zh: 各项上限不能相加超过 100%。

body.en: Frizzante and spumante expressions are recognised.
body.zh: 认可微起泡及起泡表达。

body.en: Red and rosé are both established styles.
body.zh: 红及桃红均为传统风格。

body.en: Especially light ruby or pink compared with many Lambruschi.
body.zh: 相比不少 Lambrusco，特别浅宝石红或粉红。

body.en: Violet, red berries and fresh fruit.
body.zh: 紫罗兰、红浆果、清新果味。

body.en: Marked acidity and generally lighter body than Grasparossa.
body.zh: 酸度明显，酒体通常轻于 Grasparossa。

body.zh: Sorbara 是品种，也出现在地理酒名中。

body.en: DOC

body.en: DOC for red and rosé sparkling or semi-sparkling styles.

body.en: Castelvetro and the southern Modena hills.
body.zh: Castelvetro 及 Modena 南部丘陵。

body.en: More hillside-oriented than Sorbara and Salamino’s northern plain origins.
body.zh: 相比 Sorbara、Salamino 北部平原，更具丘陵特点。

body.en: Clay-rich foothill soils are common.
body.zh: 山麓常见富黏土土壤。

body.en: Higher sites include limestone, sand and gravel materials.
body.zh: 较高地块含石灰岩、沙及砾石材料。

body.en: Lambrusco Grasparossa at least 85%.
body.zh: Lambrusco Grasparossa 至少 85%。

body.en: Other permitted Lambrusco and Malbo Gentile together up to 15%.
body.zh: 其他获准 Lambrusco、Malbo Gentile 合计最多 15%。

body.en: Dry and sweeter expressions are recognised.

body.en: Deep ruby-purple with coloured foam in red examples.
body.zh: 红酒常深宝石紫红，泡沫带色。

body.en: Dark berries, cherry and vinous fruit.
body.zh: 深色浆果、樱桃、葡萄酒果香。

body.en: Generally firmer tannin and fuller body than Sorbara.
body.zh: 通常单宁比 Sorbara 更强、酒体更厚。

body.en: Grasparossa is a grape; Castelvetro locates the denomination.
body.zh: Grasparossa 为品种，Castelvetro 标示产区。

body.en: DOC

body.en: Northern Modena plain around Carpi and Santa Croce.

body.en: Low, level river-sediment country.
body.zh: 低平河流沉积地区。

body.en: Sand, silt and clay occur in varying proportions.

body.en: Lambrusco Salamino at least 85%.

body.en: Other authorised Lambruschi may contribute to the balance.

body.en: Lambrusco styles extend from dry to sweet categories.

body.en: Ancellotta is distinct from the Lambruschi and important in Reggiano Rosso.
body.zh: Ancellotta 不同于 Lambrusco 各品种，在 Reggiano Rosso 重要。

body.en: Reggiano and Modena are separate denominations despite shared grape families.

intro.en: Reggio Emilia hill DOC with distinctive whites and several separate Lambrusco expressions.

body.en: DOC
body.zh: DOC

body.en: Multi-type DOC including whites, reds and named Lambrusco types.
body.zh: 多类型 DOC，含白、红及命名 Lambrusco 类型。

body.en: Canossa’s landscape is linked to the eleventh-century Countess Matilda.
body.zh: Canossa 景观与十一世纪 Matilda 伯爵夫人相关。

body.en: Hills of Reggio Emilia around Scandiano and Canossa.
body.zh: Reggio Emilia 的 Scandiano、Canossa 周边丘陵。

body.en: Hill substrates and slopes distinguish it from the low Reggio plain.
body.zh: 丘陵母质、坡面区别于 Reggio 低平原。

body.en: Spergola is a central local white name.
body.zh: Spergola 为核心本地白品种名。

body.en: Malvasia di Candia Aromatica is another important local white.
body.zh: Malvasia di Candia Aromatica 为另一重要本地白品种。

body.en: Maestri, Marani, Salamino and Barghi together form at least 85% in the relevant blended type.
body.zh: 相关混酿类型 Maestri、Marani、Salamino、Barghi 合计至少 85%。

body.en: The blend’s permitted complements include Malbo Gentile, Marzemino, Croatina, Sgavetta, Termarina and Perla dei Vivi.
body.zh: 混酿获准辅助包括 Malbo Gentile、Marzemino、Croatina、Sgavetta、Termarina、Perla dei Vivi。

body.en: The named Grasparossa type requires at least 85% Grasparossa.
body.zh: 命名 Grasparossa 类型要求该品种至少 85%。

body.en: The named Montericco type has its own minimum 85% rule.
body.zh: 命名 Montericco 类型有自己的至少 85% 规则。

body.en: Local white and Lambrusco expressions include frizzante styles.
body.zh: 本地白酒及 Lambrusco 表达含微起泡。

body.en: The DOC cannot be reduced to a single red blend.
body.zh: DOC 不可简化为单一红混酿。

body.en: Keep grape identity, named wine type and broader geographical origin separate.
body.zh: 须区分品种身份、命名酒类型及广域地理产地。

intro.en: Romagna’s Albana-led white DOCG, spanning dry, sweet and passito expressions.
intro.zh: Romagna 以 Albana 为主的白酒 DOCG，涵盖干、甜及风干风格。

body.en: DOCG
body.zh: DOCG

body.en: DOCG for Albana-based whites.
body.zh: Albana 白酒 DOCG。

body.en: Delimited parts of Bologna, Ravenna and Forlì-Cesena.
body.zh: Bologna、Ravenna、Forlì-Cesena 划定部分。

body.en: Romagna hill and foothill sites south of the Via Emilia corridor.
body.zh: Via Emilia 走廊南侧 Romagna 丘陵及山麓。

body.en: Albana at least 95%.
body.zh: Albana 至少 95%。

body.en: Other suitable white varieties may make up to 5%.
body.zh: 其他适宜白品种最多 5%。

body.en: Albana is distinct from Trebbiano Romagnolo.
body.zh: Albana 不同于 Trebbiano Romagnolo。

body.en: Romagna Albana Spumante DOC is a separate denomination.
body.zh: Romagna Albana Spumante DOC 为独立产区。

body.en: Secco, amabile, dolce and passito are style distinctions within this DOCG.
body.zh: Secco、amabile、dolce、passito 为本 DOCG 内风格区分。

body.en: Passito: not before 1 September following harvest; Passito Riserva: not before 1 December following harvest.
body.zh: Passito 不早于采收次年 9 月 1 日；Passito Riserva 不早于次年 12 月 1 日。

body.en: Dry white expression.
body.zh: 干白表达。

body.en: Sweeter still-white types are recognised.
body.zh: 认可较甜静止白酒类型。

body.en: Dried grapes yield a concentrated sweet style.
body.zh: 风干葡萄形成浓缩甜酒。

body.en: Dry Albana can have substantial body and a phenolic grip.
body.zh: 干型 Albana 可有厚酒体及酚类抓力。

body.en: Passito combines concentration and sweetness with acidity.
body.zh: Passito 将浓缩、甜度与酸度结合。

body.en: Albana DOCG does not imply that every wine is sweet.
body.zh: Albana DOCG 不意味着每款酒都甜。

evidence.note: Recovered primary-source research, reviewed 2026-10-26. Forty distinct new grape dossiers after Spergola identity merge; 33 regions/denominations. Photos are source-identified variety bunch images, not generic illustrations.

Consolidated 2023 laws: Corvina and/or Corvinone 45–95%, Rondinella 5–30%. Ripasso operation minimum three days; release from 1 January of the second year after harvest. Do not reuse obsolete Corvinone substitution limits.

note.en: The matched registered Spergola genotype is identical to Vernaccia di Oristano in Raimondi et al. 2020. Homonymous accessions require authentication; do not assert every historical Spergola accession is identical.
